about: Facets' DS set as a SPRITE SWAPPER pack. Deoxys is left out: SPRITE SWAPPER has one picture for every game, and each game shows its own Deoxys form, so the game's own stays. Spinda's and Anorith's fronts aren't in the set, so they stay the game's own too.
name: Facets DS Sprites
label: FACETS DS
description: Gen 4-style fronts, backs and shinies for all of Gen 3 (the DS-style 64x64 Pokémon Sprite Resource), from Facets.
notes: Deoxys, Spinda's front and Anorith's front stay the game's own.
